\paragraph{Owner-approved protocol audit.}
A deterministic 10\% caveat-only assisted review, with final judgments approved by the project owner, inspected 12/120 Wiki-VISA and 10/100 VizWiz-LF rows for image dependence and THINKING quality. Wiki image-dependence labels were {'borderline': 1, 'supported': 11}; VizWiz labels were {'borderline': 1, 'supported': 8, 'unsupported': 1}. No review changed the frozen sample set.
